newsitem.title: UK: Shield to develop amino acid test under deal.
newsitem.headline: Shield to develop amino acid test under deal.

text.p: Britain's Shield Diagnostics Plc said on Monday it signed an exclusive worldwide deal to commercialise a new way of measuring homocysteine, an amino acid found in blood.
High levels of homocysteine in the blood causes increased risk of thrombosis, which can lead to a heart attack or stroke.
Once identified, the condition is easily treatable with dietary supplements.
Shield said its agreement with the University of Glasgow would allow it to develop an easy-to-use test for the amino acid that can be used in routine laboratories on a screening basis.
